question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

She was __engaged to be married __to him.
solution:
The correct answer is: Betrothed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"betrothed"** means someone who is engaged to be married. (मंगेतर)
 
• **​"Betrothed" **is used to indicate a formal agreement to marry.
 
 
• **Example: **He gave her a ring when they became **betrothed**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Betrayed **(धोखा देना): To be disloyal or unfaithful to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt **betrayed **when his friend revealed his secret.
 
 
 
• **Bestowed **(प्रदान करना): To give something as an honour or gift.
 
 
• **Example: **The queen **bestowed **a knighthood on the brave soldier.
 
 
 
• **Baptised **(बपतिस्मा देना): A religious ceremony of initiation, especially in Christianity.
 
 
• **Example:** The baby was **baptised **in the church last Sunday.
